utme_subjects: and any of Chemistry, Geography, Art, Biology, Economics
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and any of Fine Art, Geography or Wood Work, Biology, Economics, Technical Drawing, Further Mathematics, Introduction to Building Construction, Bricklaying/Block laying, Concreting, Wall Floors and Ceiling Finishing, Joinery, Carpentry, Decorative Painting, Lining, Sign and Design, Wall Hanging, Colour Mixing/Matching and Glazing, Ceramics, Graphics Design, Graphic Printing, Basic Electricity
direct_entry: (i) Two (2) 'A' Level passes chosen from Mathematics or Physics and Chemistry, Geography or Fine Arts. (ii) ND/HND upper credits in relevant field.

institution_waivers.note: For Quantity Surveying: a) 'A' level/IJMB passes in Mathematics and Physics; b) ND at Upper Credit in Quantity Surveying; c) HND at Lower credit in Quantity Surveying from accredited institution. For Surveying and Geoinformatics: a) two (2) A Level passes chosen from Mathematics or Physics and Chemistry, Geography or Fine Arts; b) ND/HND upper credits in relevant field. For Land Surveying: a) two 'A' Level/IJMB passes in Mathematics and any of Physics, Chemistry or Geography; b) ND at Upper Credit in Land Surveying/Geomatics, Geoinformatics, Civil Engineering, Physics/Mathematics, Building; c) HND at Lower Credit in Land Surveying/Geomatics, Civil Engineering.

Accepts a) for Quantity Surveying 'A' Level/IJMB or equivalent passes in Mathematics, Physics and any of Chemistry, Technical Drawing, Fine Arts, Geography, Economics, Building Construction, Information Technology and Land Surveying; b) NCE merit/credit, ND/HND lower credit in Surveying/Geoinformatics, Photogrammetry, Cartography, Civil Engineering, Building Construction and Architecture; c) for Surveying and Geoinformatics, two (2) 'A' Level passes or equivalent in Mathematics, Physics and any of Chemistry, Technical Drawing, Fine Arts, Geography, Economics, Building Construction and Land Surveying; d) ND/HND upper credit in programmes relevant to Architecture.

Accepts a) two (2) 'A' Level passes in Mathematics, Physics and Economics (for Survey and Geoinformatics Chemistry instead of Economics); b) ND/HND upper credit in Quantity Surveying (for Survey and Geoinformatics ND/HND upper credit in Land Surveying).
Requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes at one sitting in English Language, Mathematics and Physics and any other two from Chemistry, Technical Drawing, Economics, Further Mathematics and Biology.

Accepts a) first degree in relevant programmes and HND upper credit into 400 level of the five-year programme; b) ND lower credit; c) for Quantity Surveying 'A' Level/ND upper credit in Building and Quantity Surveying; d) for Surveying and Geoinformatics, two 'A' level passes in Mathematics and Physics plus UTME requirements, accepts ND/HND in Land Surveying and Geoinformatics from Federal School of Surveying or other NBTE accredited institution; e) 'A' Level Cambridge; f) ND upper credit into 200 level from Federal School of Surveying or other NBTE accredited institution.

Accepts a) 'A' Level passes at Credit level (CIE/IJMB/JUPEB) or equivalent in at least two of Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Geography and Economics; b) ND at Upper Credit level in Quantity Surveying or Building Technology or other relevant fields in Environmental Design and Management. For Surveying and Geoinformatics: a) ND in Surveying and Geoinformatics or related field with minimum Upper credit from NBTE-accredited programme; b) GCE or equivalent with minimum credit in at least two subjects including Mathematics and Physics.

Requires a) at least three 'A' Level passes not below C in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry; b) ND/HND at Upper Credit in Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Geology, Environmental Sciences or Engineering; c) First Degree in same fields; d) very good passes in three JUPEB subjects (Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry). Does not accept NCE; candidates must also meet 'O' Level requirements. Same requirements apply for Quantity Surveying.

Accepts a) Advanced level, H.S.C/IJMB or equivalent passes in Mathematics and Physics or any of Geography, Technical Drawing, Economics, Chemistry, Commerce, Building Construction and Biology into 200 level; b) OND certificate in Quantity Surveying, Building, Architecture and allied professions at upper credit level into 200 level; c) HND in Quantity Surveying with Upper credits in both ND and HND into 300 level.
No Direct Entry; accepts ND credit in Land Surveying and 'A' Level passes in Mathematics and Physics plus UTME requirements into 200 level; 'O' Level credit pass in Geography an advantage.
Same as in Architecture.

For Surveying and Geoinformatics accepts very good passes in JUPEB subjects Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry, 'A' level Cambridge, HND/ND (minimum Upper Credit) into 200 level, Federal School of Surveying Certificate into 300 level at minimum Upper Credit. For Quantity Surveying accepts very good passes in JUPEB/A' Level subjects Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Economics and Geography, HND/ND (Upper Credits) in relevant field into 300/200 level.
Accepts a) IJMB/GCE two (2) A Level passes chosen from Mathematics and Physics; b) ND/HND with Lower credits in Surveying, Physics or any other relevant field.

Accepts ND upper credit or HND lower credit plus UTME requirements; accepts ND/HND lower credit in relevant programmes and requires 'O' Level credit passes in Mathematics, Physics and any other two relevant subjects.

Requires a) 'A' Level passes in Mathematics and any two from Physics, Chemistry, Economics and Geography; b) HND upper credit in Surveying, Civil Engineering, Building and Agricultural Engineering from NBTE accredited institutions.

Accepts ND/HND and Federal School of Survey Advanced Certificate Part II; a) for Land Surveying, ND upper credit or Federal School of Surveying Advanced Certificate Part II or ND in Surveying and Geoinformatics or 'A' Level passes in Mathematics and Physics into second year; b) for Quantity Surveying, ND upper credit in relevant programmes plus UTME requirements, and HND lower credit in relevant programmes for admission into Year III.
Accepts ND/HND in relevant programmes plus the UTME requirements.

Accepts a) 'A' Level passes in Mathematics and Physics or equivalents plus UTME requirements; b) ND upper credit or equivalent in Surveying from NBTE accredited institutions; c) first degree in the Physical Sciences and Engineering programmes.

Requires a) ND upper or lower credit in Land Surveying or Surveying and Geoinformatics; b) Advanced Technical Certificate from Federal School of Surveying, Oyo; c) 'A' Level passes in three of Physics, Mathematics, Geography, Economics, Chemistry plus 'O' Level credit pass in English Language; d) HND lower or upper credit in Land Surveying or Surveying and Geoinformatics, Mathematics, Computer Science, GIS, Physics; e) university degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Geography with Mathematics and Physics bias; f) ND from Polytechnics or Federal School of Survey, Oyo; g) candidates to sit and pass university aptitude test plus UTME requirements.
Accepts two 'A' Level passes in Mathematics/Physics and Chemistry, ND/HND Lower Credit in related field, IJMB/GCE 'A' Level 7 points and above in addition to 'O' Level requirements.

UTME: a) for Quantity Survey, five 'O' level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics plus any two of Chemistry, Economics, Geography, Technical Drawing, Biology, Commerce, Woodwork, Building Construction; b) for Surveying and Geoinformatics, five SSC credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and any of Fine Art, Geography or Wood Work, Biology, Economics, Technical Drawing, Further Mathematics and building trade subjects; c) for Land Surveying, five 'O' level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Geography and any other Science subject.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two from Chemistry, Technical Drawing, Geography, Biology, Information Technology or Land Surveying.

UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Economics and any one from Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Economics; for Survey and Geoinformatics, five 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and any one from Biology and Geography.

UTME: for Surveying and Geoinformatics, 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two from Chemistry, Geography, Biology, Technical Drawing, Fine and Applied Arts and Economics; also requires five 'O' Level credit passes to include Mathematics, Physics, English Language and any other science subject; accepts either Physics or Chemistry.

UTME: requires five (5) SSC credit passes at maximum two sittings in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two of Chemistry, Economics, Building Construction, Technical Drawing, Geography, Government. For Surveying and Geoinformatics, five SSC credit passes in Mathematics, Physics, English Language and any two of Geography, Elementary Surveying, Technical Drawing, Chemistry, Economics, Fine Art, Biology/Agricultural Science.

UTME: requires at least five 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and any one of Fine Arts, Technical Drawing, Geography, Economics and Biology in not more than two sittings. For Quantity Surveying, at least five 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and any other science subject in not more than two sittings; at least a Pass required in Biology.
UTME: accepts Mathematics and any other subject.

UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry and any one of Geography, Fine Arts, Woodwork, Technical Drawing, Biology or Economics plus ND upper credit.

UTME: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any subjects from Technical Drawing, Economics, Geography, Chemistry, Biology, Commerce, Building Construction, Land Surveying and Fine Arts.

UTME: a) for Quantity Survey, five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two of Geography, Chemistry, Technical Drawing and Economics; b) for Survey and Geoinformatics, five O/Level credit passes in English, Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
UTME: requires five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two from Geography, Biology, Agric Science, Technical Drawing, Further Mathematics.
UTME: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry/Geography and any other subject from Economics, Biology, Technical Drawing and Further Mathematics.
UTME: same as in Architecture.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including Physics, English Language, Chemistry, Mathematics and any Science subject from Geography, Technical Drawing and Economics.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any three of Physics, Chemistry, Building Construction and/or Technical Drawing.
UTME: accepts Technical Drawing, Fine Arts and Economics; accepts 'O' Level Pass in English Language.
UTME: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including Mathematics, Physics and English Language.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and Physics plus any two from Chemistry, Economics, Geography and Technical Drawing.

UTME: requires five (5) SSCE credits in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any other subjects from Geography, Technical Drawing, Economics, Chemistry, Commerce, Building Construction and Biology.
UTME: requires five 'O' level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Physics and two other Science subjects.

UTME SUBJECTS: for Quantity Survey, Mathematics, Physics and any of Chemistry, Economics and Geography; for Surveying and Geoinformatics, Physics, Mathematics and any of Chemistry, Geography, Art, Biology and Economics; for Land Surveying, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry or Geography.
UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics, Physics and any of Chemistry, Technical Drawing, Geography, Biology, Information Technology or Land Surveying.
UTME SUBJECTS: accepts Economics for Quantity Surveying.
UTME SUBJECTS: for Surveying and Geoinformatics, Mathematics, Physics and any one from Chemistry, Geography, Economics, Government, Biology or Agricultural Science.

UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics and Physics plus one subject from Chemistry, Building Construction, Technical Drawing, Geography, Economics and Government. For Surveying and Geoinformatics, Mathematics, Physics and either Chemistry or Geography.
UTME SUBJECTS: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics, Physics and Geography.

UTME SUBJECTS: a) for Quantity Surveying, English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any one of Chemistry, Economics or Geography; b) for Surveying and Geo-Informatics, English Language, Chemistry, Mathematics and Physics.
UTME SUBJECTS: Physics, Mathematics and any one of Chemistry, Geography, Biology/Agric Science and Economics.
UTME SUBJECTS: English, Mathematics, Physics, Geography or Chemistry.
UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics, Physics and one other subject.
UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics, Physics and any one of Geography, Technical Drawing, Economics, Chemistry.
UTME SUBJECTS: Mathematics, Physics and one other Science subject.
